category_title: Struggling and reluctant middle school learners in intervention language arts
scenario_title: Group reading out loud without prior practice
minimal_context: The student is participating in a Reading and Discussion rotation where they are asked to read assigned pages from the novel 'Stargirl' out loud to the group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright, it's time for our Reading and Discussion rotation. We are going to take turns reading the assigned pages from 'Stargirl' out loud to the group.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Whispers to a peer) I'm not reading this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Jesse, please start us off by reading the first page out loud.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I didn't get to practice it by myself first. I'm not doing it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just give it a try. Read the first paragraph for us.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Puts head down on the desk, refusing to work) No. I'm not reading out loud in front of everyone.
